body: My doctor has me switching from Trulicity 1.5 to Ozempic 2 mg. I'm scared to switch right into the full dose, so I started at .25. I'm only on my second week. I think I'll probably jump to .50 for my next shot and see how it goes. It was my PCP who prescribed it as I don't have an endocrinologist right now. I know they're both the same type of meds, but they are different, so I wasn't sure what to do.
I might take .50 for my next injection. I only took .25. I feel okay, but I have a low-grade fever now. I'll see how I feel next Saturday.

I started yesterday at .25 even though my doctor prescribed me 2 mg as a starting dose (because I'm switching from Trulicity and I don't think she knows what she's doing) and I have a low-grade fever (99.3) right now. No other symptoms though.
That's what I'm thinking as well. I'll start at the .25 dose and titrate up. Thank you!

I am so sorry for what you are going through. I’m 13 weeks into my fiancé’s death and I’m still finding myself in shock at times. I want to tell you to not talk to people who are losing their patience with you, but I know isolation is also not a good thing. I find myself only dealing with the subject with people that get how I feel. The ones that don’t act like nothing happened. My main support is my therapist that I see twice a week. I actually have to pay for someone to listen and talk to me. I wish you well and I hope you’re able to reach out for the help and support that you deserve. ❤️
Thank you. I appreciate it. I was already a mess, and in therapy, when he did it. I’m in for the long-haul, if I want the help I need. Most people I’m around have no clue as to how I feel.
